en: Jātaka: The Second Book of Birth Stories (Dukanipāta),
3. The Vikaṇṇaka Jātaka “Go wherever you wish, as you please;
you have been pierced in the vital spot by Vikaṇṇaka.”
“Eating well-prepared food and chasing after fish with greed—
thus one falls into the bait of worldly things.”
One who follows the dictates of the mind suffers;
he is destroyed in the midst of his kinsmen and friends,
like a crocodile following a fish.
The Third Jātaka: The Story of Vikaṇṇa.
